Excluded: Table 1 (annual and five-year rows, their models and controls) and the preferred specification re-estimated without these countries. Realigned: for fiscal years starting between April and September (EGY, HKG, IRN, LSO, MUS, NPL, RWA, SGP), the calendar-year ratio is the month-weighted average of the two fiscal years that overlap the calendar year, assuming each fiscal year is labelled by the calendar year that holds most of its months; measures over trend GDP and five-year measures are recomputed from the realigned ratio. Annual rows: Driscoll-Kraay standard errors; five-year rows: standard errors clustered by country. Differences: measures (or full and restricted samples) stacked with measure- or sample-specific fixed effects, controls and year effects; wild cluster bootstrap by country (Webb weights, 9,999 replications).
